message: If you both have two clubs cards, trade one card blindly with your opponent.

name: Face to Face
message: If you have a face card (Jack, Queen, or King), reveal 1 to your opponent.

name: Suit Swap
message: If you have two cards of the same suit higher than 9, draw a card from your opponent.

name: Prime Time
message: If you have any card (2, 3, 5), draw 1 card.

name: Drawback
message: If you have two cards of the same number, drop one card of your choice.
If you have three 3's, draw 5 cards.

name: Double Face
message: If you have two kings, draw 1 card.

name: Swap & Reveal
message: If both of you have two cards of the same suit, swap a card with your opponent.

name: All Red
message: If all your cards are red, drop a card from your opponent's hand.

name: Ace of Spades
message: If you have the Ace of Spades, reveal it to your opponent and draw 1 card.

name: Lucky Leap
message: If you have 3 consecutive number cards, draw 1 card.

name: Double Double
message: If you have two face cards and a 2, draw 2 cards.

name: Full Spectrum
message: If your hand contains one card of each suit, draw 1 card.

name: King’s Luck
message: If you have a King, drop a card of your choice and draw 1 card.

name: Fool’s Hand
message: If you have no face cards, drop 1 card from your hand.

name: Royal Blessing
message: If you have a Jack and a Queen, reveal one card from your opponent’s hand.

name: Color Swap
message: If you have four black cards, drop one.
